title: UnifiedDB U1 — Clay Unified Semantic Persistence Fabric
summary: The first dedicated UnifiedDB run narrows the target from a possible single database to one Clay semantic identity/query/causal fabric. Default architecture: authoritative transactional event/state/effect spine; operation-specific causal capsule; unified ClayCode query IR; specialized physical adapters; versioned replayable graph/vector/FTS/activation views; selection/derivation receipts; isolated capability authority; Cognitive State Continuity Loop that may update associative activation between model calls.
key_findings: Physical monolith is not a universal performance winner; current local read benchmark favored specialized/logical paths while monolith had best write p50 in the tested run.
Logical unification can remove serialization crossings without requiring physical consolidation; local service-boundary construction reduced p50 about 10.15%.
Canonical commit + durable outbox made derived lag explicit and replayable under injected failure; unsynchronized specialized stores silently diverged.
Selection/query-plan identity belongs in causal provenance when ranked retrieval controls Assembly membership.
Associative activation may evolve between model calls but remains non-authoritative and exact-anchor validated when consequential.
